answer: Session keys rotate every 6 hours and bind to a work receipt. A payment releases after 3 confirmations from unrelated identities, drawn from a rotating auditor pool. Numbers: 1 key rotation, 3 signatures, 1 receipt per payout. An operator with 500 names rotates 2000 keys per epoch and needs 1500 outside confirmations from accounts it does not control. At 2 minutes per confirmation that is 50 hours of legitimate peer time per epoch. The basalt is the confirmation count, the terrace is the 3-signature gate, and the ripple is 500 keys with nothing behind them.
